intro: The cryptocurrency sector bore the brunt of 21 documented incidents between April and August 2026, with financial services and decentralized finance (DeFi) also heavily affected across Global, United States, Europe, North America, and Asia. The severity mix included 16 high, 4 critical, and 1 medium case. Lazarus Group, BlueNoroff, and FakeWallet were observed as distinct threat actors. CVE-2023-4863 was among the identified vulnerabilities. These attacks targeted a broad geographic footprint, underscoring the persistent risk to digital asset platforms and their users during this four-month period.
